synthesis:draft.headline: AEMO published a PDPASA Forecast Lack Of Reserve Level 1 (LOR1) for South Australia for the early evening of 2026-07-29; AEMO later cancelled that Forecast LOR1 before the day.
summary: AEMO issued a PDPASA market notice declaring a Forecast LOR1 for SA for 29/07/2026 covering the early evening period; that notice is recorded in the retrieved market notices.
AEMO subsequently issued a cancellation notice that cancels the Forecast LOR1 before 2026-07-29.
The forecast and the actual operational demand for the half-hour identified as 2026-07-29T08:30:00Z (2026-07-29 18:00 ACST) are available in the forecast-vs-actual comparison results.

possible_explanations.statement: The Forecast LOR1 cancellation may reflect an updated PDPASA or PDP assessment that removed the shortfall (see the cancellation notice [c2]).
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Compare PDPASA/PDP notices and runs published around 2026-07-28T03:44:57Z (the publication_date returned for the cancellation notice) and subsequent PDPASA publications to see whether later published reserve estimates replaced the LOR1 advice.

possible_explanations.statement: The LOR1 declaration may have reflected earlier forecast-led reserve shortfall projections that by the evening target interval were not observed in operational demand or in later forecasts (see the PDPASA LOR1 notice [c1]).
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Compare the PDPASA run available at 2026-07-29T07:48:19Z (run_available_at_utc for the paired forecast for target_end_utc 2026-07-29T08:30:00Z) with the actual operational demand at interval_end_utc 2026-07-29T08:30:00Z and with the sequence of PDPASA/PDP runs published between the original LOR1 notice and the cancellation.
